register.name: PCI_ACK_LATENCY_TIMER_OFF
register.comment: Ack Latency Timer and Replay Timer Register. This register holds the ack latency timer limit and replay timer limit values.

register.name: PCI_VENDOR_SPEC_DLLP_OFF
register.comment: Vendor Specific DLLP Register. This register holds the vendor specific DLLP.

register.name: PCI_PORT_FORCE_OFF
register.comment: Port Force Link Register. This register can be used for testing and debuggong the link.

register.name: PCI_ACK_F_ASPM_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Ack Frequency and L0-L1 ASPM Control Register. This register is used to control ack frequency and L0-L1 ASPM behaviour.

register.name: PCI_PORT_LINK_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Port Link Control Register. Using this register you can control the port link behaviour.

register.name: PCI_LANE_SKEW_OFF
register.comment: Lane Skew Register. This register is used to control the lane skew behaviour.

register.name: PCI_TIMER_CTRL_MAX_FUNC_NUM_OFF
register.comment: Timer Control and Max Function Number Register. This register holds the ack frequency, latency, replay, fast link scaling timers, and max function number values.

register.name: PCI_SYMBOL_TIMER_FILTER_1_OFF
register.comment: Symbol Timer Register and Filter Mask 1 Register. The Filter Mask 1 Register modifies the RADM filtering and error handling rules. For more information, see the 'Receive Filtering' section. In each case, '0' applies the associated filtering rule and '1' masks the associated filtering rule.

register.name: PCI_FILTER_MASK_2_OFF
register.comment: Filter Mask 2 Register. This register modifies the RADM filtering and error handling rules. For more information, see the 'Receive Filtering' section. In each case, '0' applies the associated filtering rule and '1' masks the associated filtering rule.

register.name: PCI_PL_DEBUG0_OFF
register.comment: Debug Register 0. This register holds cxpl_debug_info[31:0].

register.name: PCI_PL_DEBUG1_OFF
register.comment: Debug Register 1. This register holds cxpl_debug_info[63:32].

register.name: PCI_TX_P_FC_CREDIT_STATUS_OFF
register.comment: Transmit Posted FC Credit Status. This register provides transmit posted FC credit status.

register.name: PCI_TX_NP_FC_CREDIT_STATUS_OFF
register.comment: Transmit Non-Posted FC Credit Status. This register provides the transmit Non-Posted FC credit status.

register.name: PCI_TX_CPL_FC_CREDIT_STATUS_OFF
register.comment: Transmit Completion FC Credit Status This register provides transmit completion FC credit status.

register.name: PCI_QUEUE_STATUS_OFF
register.comment: Queue Status. This register provides the queue status.

register.name: PCI_VC_TX_ARBI_1_OFF
register.comment: VC Transmit Arbitration Register 1. This register is used for setting the WRR weights for VC0 - VC3.

register.name: PCI_VC_TX_ARBI_2_OFF
register.comment: VC Transmit Arbitration Register 2. This register is used for setting the WRR weights for VC4 - VC7.

register.name: PCI_VC0_P_RX_Q_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Segmented-Buffer VC0 Posted Receive Queue Control. This register controls segmented-buffer VC0 posted receive queue operation.

register.name: PCI_VC0_NP_RX_Q_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Segmented-Buffer VC0 Non-Posted Receive Queue Control. This register controls the segmented-buffer VC0 non-posted receive queue operation.

register.name: PCI_VC0_CPL_RX_Q_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Segmented-Buffer VC0 Completion Receive Queue Control. This register controls the segmented-buffer VC0 completion receive queue operation.

register.name: PCI_GEN2_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Link Width and Speed Change Control Register. This register controls various functions of the controller related to link training, lane reversal, and equalization.

register.name: PCI_PHY_STATUS_OFF
register.comment: PHY Status Register. Memory mapped register from phy_cfg_status GPIO input pins.

register.name: PCI_PHY_CONTROL_OFF
register.comment: PHY Control Register. Memory mapped register to cfg_phy_control GPIO output pins.

register.name: PCI_TRGT_MAP_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Programmable Target Map Control Register. This register controls the target map.

register.name: PCI_CLOCK_GATING_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Clock Gating Control Register. This register enables you to disable dynamic clock gating. By default dynamic clock gating is on, allowing the controller to autonomously enable and disable its clocks. The clock gating is performed in the clock and reset module, DWC_pcie_clk_rst.v, and is initiated by the controllers clock enable signals. The following modules support dynamic clock gating: - AXI Bridge - RADM

register.name: PCI_GEN3_RELATED_OFF
register.comment: Gen3 Control Register. There is no Gen3-specific N_FTS field. The N_FTS field in the 'Link Width and Speed Change Control Register' is used for both Gen2 and Gen3 speed modes. There is no Gen3-specific 'Directed Speed Change' field. The 'Directed Speed Change' field in the 'Link Width and Speed Change Control Register' is used to change to Gen2 or Gen3 speed. A speed change to Gen3 occurs if (1) the 'Directed Speed Change' field is set to '1' and (2) the 'Target Link Speed' field in the Link Control 2 Register is set to Gen3. Gen3 support is advertised by both sides of the link during link training.

register.name: PCI_GEN3_EQ_CONTROL_OFF
register.comment: Gen3 EQ Control Register. This register controls equalization for Phase2 in an upstream port (USP), or Phase3 in a downstream port (DSP).

register.name: PCI_GEN3_EQ_FB_MODE_DIR_CHANGE_OFF
register.comment: Gen3 EQ Direction Change Feedback Mode Control Register. Equalization controls to be used in Phase2 (USP) or Phase 3 (DSP), when you set the Feedback Mode in 'Gen3 EQ Control Register' to 'Direction Change.' These fields allow control over the initial starting point for the search of optimal coefficient settings, and allow control over the criteria used to determine when the optimal settings have been achieved. The values are applied to all the lanes.

register.name: PCI_ORDER_RULE_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: Order Rule Control Register. This register controls the order rule.

register.name: PCI_PIPE_LOOPBACK_CONTROL_OFF
register.comment: PIPE Loopback Control Register. This register controls the PIPE Loopback.

register.name: PCI_MISC_CONTROL_1_OFF
register.comment: DBI Read-Only Write Enable Register. This is the DBI Read-Only write enable register.

register.name: PCI_MULTI_LANE_CONTROL_OFF
register.comment: UpConfigure Multi-lane Control Register. Used when upsizing or downsizing the link width through Configuration state without bringing the link down. For more information, see the 'Link Establishment' section in the 'Controller Operations' chapter of the Databook.

register.name: PCI_PHY_INTEROP_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: PHY Interoperability Control Register. This register controls the PHY interoperability.

register.name: PCI_TRGT_CPL_LUT_DELETE_ENTRY_OFF
register.comment:
TRGT_CPL_LUT Delete Entry Control register. Using this register you can delete one entry in the target completion LUT. You should only use this register when you know that your application will never send the completion because of an FLR or any other reason.
Note:: The target completion LUT (and associated target completion timeout event) is watching for completions (from your application on XALI0/1/2 or AXI master read channel) corresponding to previously received non-posted requests from the PCIe wire.

register.name: PCI_LINK_FLUSH_CONTROL_OFF
register.comment: Link Reset Request Flush Control Register. This register controls link reset request flush behaviour.

register.name: PCI_AMBA_ERROR_RESPONSE_DEFAULT_OFF
register.comment: AXI Bridge Slave Error Response Register. This register holds the AXI bridge slave error responses.

register.name: PCI_AMBA_LINK_TIMEOUT_OFF
register.comment: Link Down AXI Bridge Slave Timeout Register. If your application AXI master issues outbound requests to the AXI bridge slave interface before the PCIe link is operational, the controller starts a 'flush' timer. The timeout value of the timer is set by this register. If the timer times out before the PCIe link is operational, the bridge TX request queues are flushed. For more information, see the 'AXI Bridge Initialization, Clocking and Reset' section in the AXI chapter of the Databook.

register.name: PCI_AMBA_ORDERING_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: AXI Bridge Ordering Control. This register controls the AXI Bridge Ordering.

register.name: PCI_COHERENCY_CONTROL_1_OFF
register.comment: Cache Coherency Control Register 1. This register controls the cache coherency operation.

register.name: PCI_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF
register.comment: Cache Coherency Control Register 3. This register controls the cache coherency operation.

register.name: PCI_AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_LOW_OFF
register.comment: Lower 32-bits of the Programmable AXI Address. Lower 20 bits of the programmable AXI address to which Messages coming from wire are mapped. Bits [11:0] of the register are tied to zero for the address to be 4k-aligned. In previous releases, the third and fourth DWORDs of a message (Msg/MsgD) TLP header were delivered though the AXI master address bus (mstr_awaddr). These DWORDS are now supplied through the mstr_awmisc_info_hdr_34dw[63:0] output; and the value on mstr_awaddr is driven to the value you have programmed into the AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_LOW_OFF and AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_HIGH_OFF registers.

register.name: PCI_AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_HIGH_OFF
register.comment: Upper 32-bits of the Programmable AXI Address. Upper 32 bits of the programmable AXI address to which Messages coming from wire are mapped.

register.name: PCIE_VERSION_NUMBER_OFF
register.comment:
PCIe Controller IIP Release Version Number. The version number is given in hex format. You should convert each pair of hex characters to ASCII to interpret.
Using 4.70a (GA) as an example: - VERSION_NUMBER = 0x3437302a which translates to 470* - VERSION_TYPE = 0x67612a2a which translates to ga** Using 4.70a-ea01 as an example: - VERSION_NUMBER = 0x3437302a which translates to 470* - VERSION_TYPE = 0x65613031 which translates to ea01 GA is a general release available on www.designware.com
EA is an early release available on a per-customer basis.

register.name: PCIE_VERSION_TYPE_OFF
register.comment:
PCIe Controller IIP Release Version Type. The type is given in hex format. You should convert each pair of hex characters to ASCII to interpret.
Using 4.70a (GA) as an example: - VERSION_NUMBER = 0x3437302a which translates to 470* - VERSION_TYPE = 0x67612a2a which translates to ga** Using 4.70a-ea01 as an example: - VERSION_NUMBER = 0x3437302a which translates to 470* - VERSION_TYPE = 0x65613031 which translates to ea01 GA is a general release available on www.designware.com
EA is an early release available on a per-customer basis.

register.name: PCI_MSIX_ADDRESS_MATCH_LOW_OFF
register.comment: MSI-X Address Match Low Register. When you enable the MSI-X Table RAM feature (MSIX_TABLE_EN=1), the controller implements the logic and RAM required to generate MSI-X requests. For more information, see the Interrupts section in the 'Controller Operations' chapter of the Databook. This register is only used in AXI configurations. When your local AXI application writes (MWr) to the address defined in this register (and MSIX_ADDRESS_MATCH_HIGH_OFF), the controller will load the MSIX_DOORBELL_OFF register with the contents of the MWr and subsequently create and send MSI-X TLPs

register.name: PCI_MSIX_ADDRESS_MATCH_HIGH_OFF
register.comment: MSIX Address Match High Register. MSI-X Address Match High Register. When you enable the MSI-X Table RAM feature (MSIX_TABLE_EN=1), the controller implements the logic and RAM required to generate MSI-X requests. For more information, see the Interrupts section in the 'Controller Operations' chapter of the Databook. This register is only used in AXI configurations. When your local AXI application writes (MWr) to the address defined in this register (and MSIX_ADDRESS_MATCH_LOW_OFF), the controller will load the MSIX_DOORBELL_OFF register with the contents of the MWr and subsequently create and send MSI-X TLPs

register.name: PCI_MSIX_DOORBELL_OFF
register.comment: MSI-X Doorbell Register. When you enable the MSI-X Table RAM feature (MSIX_TABLE_EN=1), the controller implements the logic and RAM required to generate MSI-X requests. For more information, see the Interrupts section in the 'Controller Operations' chapter of the Databook. - For AXI configurations: when your local application writes (MWr) to the address defined in MSIX_ADDRESS_MATCH_LOW_OFF, the controller will load this register with the contents of the MWr and subsequently create and send MSI-X TLPs. - For non-AMBA configurations: when your local application writes to this register, the controller will create and send MSI-X TLPs.

register.name: PCI_MSIX_RAM_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: MSI-X RAM power mode and debug control register. When you enable the MSI-X Table RAM feature (MSIX_TABLE_EN=1), the controller implements the logic and RAM required to generate MSI-X requests. For more information, see the Interrupts section in the 'Controller Operations' chapter of the Databook.

register.name: PCI_PL_APP_BUS_DEV_NUM_STATUS_OFF
register.comment:
Application driven bus and device number register.
This register reflects the application driven bus and device number.

register.name: PCIPM_TRAFFIC_CTRL_OFF
register.comment: TLP Traffic during Non-D0 State Control Register. This register provides control over TLP Traffic during Non-D0 States.

register.name: PCI_PL_LTR_LATENCY_OFF
register.comment: LTR Latency Register. The function of this register field (and all other fields in this register) differs between an upstream port and a downstream port. For an upstream port, the register fields capture the corresponding fields in the LTR messages that are transmitted by the port. For a downstream port, the register fields capture the corresponding fields in the LTR messages that are received by the port. The full content of the register is reflected on the app_ltr_latency[31:0] output.

register.name: PCI_AUX_CLK_FREQ_OFF
register.comment: Auxiliary Clock Frequency Control Register. This register controls the auxiliary clock frequency.

register.name: PCI_L1_SUBSTATES_OFF
register.comment: L1 Substates Timing Register. This register holds L1 substates timing information.

register.name: PCI_POWERDOWN_CTRL_STATUS_OFF
register.comment: Powerdown Control and Status Register. This is the Powerdown Control and Status register.

register.name: PCI_PIPE_RELATED_OFF
register.comment: PIPE Related Register. This register controls the PIPE's capabitity, control, and status parameters.
